**Goal:** Detect price-oracle manipulation and share-pricing / token-accounting attacks.

**Technique:**
Target functions that DERIVE A VALUE from contract state that an attacker can move. Two common shapes in THIS ABI:

Move the underlying balance/reserve first (deposit/donate/transfer tokens straight to the contract, sync*, skim*), then mint/redeem shares so the stale-vs-fresh ratio pays out more than was put in.
